displayName: OCI-LAT-0707: Lateral Movement: Kerberoasting Followed by Lateral Movement
description:
Correlation rule detecting kerberoasting followed by lateral movement

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_lateral_movement_lat_0707", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%lateral%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%movement%') AND "value" > 0
